title: Show Git operations in the Edge terminal
acceptance: Every Git and GitHub command in an Edge session runs in the OpenCode terminal tab with a visible work-item banner, and the lifecycle skill documents the naming, stacked-PR and commit-trailer rules.
evidence: PR #4 on `edge-opencode/wi-009-visible-git`, stacked on `edge-opencode/wi-008-scrum-workspace`: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/4. Adds the OpenCode terminal skill and driver, `Show-GitContext.ps1`, `Work-Item` and `Agent` commit trailers, stacked-PR rules and the visible-execution rule in the lifecycle skill and AGENTS guide. Verified in the terminal tab: driver tests 8/8, `npm test` 12/12, `validate` ok with 25 records, and every Git step printed above the prompt. Limits: base retargets to `codex/development-workspace` after PR #3 merges; owner acceptance pending.
